mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_action_logs ( admin_id, action_type, target_type, target_id, reason, ip_address, created_at ) VALUES ( #{adminId}, #{actionType}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{reason}, #{ipAddress}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin_action_logs) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reports r WHERE r.status IN ('RESOLVED', 'REJECTED') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM admin_action_logs action_log WHERE action_log.action_type = 'RESOLVE_REPORT' AND action_log.target_type = 'REPORT' AND action_log.target_id = r.report_id ))
